title: $L^2$ contractivity of the noise operator
statement:
Let $\rho\in\bbr$ satisfy $\rho^2\le 1$, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean
function. Then the noise operator $T_\rho$ does not increase the $L^2$ norm under the
uniform measure:
\[
  \E\!\left[(T_\rho f)^2\right] \;\le\; \E\!\left[f^2\right].
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $\rho^2 \le 1$ and any Boolean function $f$,
\[
  \E[(T_\rho f)^2] \le \bigl(\E[f^2]\bigr)^1,
\]
the $q = 2$ instance, which is just contractivity.
